title: 6 Day Push/Pull/Legs (PPL) Powerbuilding Workout Split & Meal Plan
author: Muscle & Strength

d.t: Push Workout A - Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
ex: Flat Barbell Bench Press (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)
Seated Tricep Extensions (Dumbbell, Rope, or EZ Bar)

d.t: Pull Workout A - Back, Traps & Biceps
ex: Barbell Conventional Deadlift (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)

d.t: Legs Workout A - Quads, Hamstrings & Calves
ex: Barbell Back Squat (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)

d.t: Push Workout B - Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
ex: Standing Overhead Press (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)
Standing Tricep Pushdown (Rope, V-bar, or Straight Bar)

d.t: Pull Workout B - Back, Traps & Biceps
ex: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)

d.t: Legs Workout B - Quads, Hamstrings & Calves
ex: Barbell Front Squat (Use 20% less weight than your previous working sets)
